name: MonarchSecretField
title: SecretField
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField (through MonarchTextField) with androidx.compose.ui.text.input.PasswordVisualTransformation, androidx.compose.foundation.selection.toggleable for the reveal toggle, and MonarchCopyButton with a sensitive ClipData
summary: A masked secret such as an API key or a token, with a toggle that shows it as text, an optional copy button and a saved-but-not-shown state.
whenToUse: For API keys, tokens, webhook and signing secrets that people paste, check or copy in a settings or developer screen.
whenNotToUse: For an account password use MonarchPasswordInput, which sets the password autofill type. For a value that is not secret use MonarchCopyField.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchSecretField(value: String, label: String, onValueChange: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, saved: Boolean = false, revealable: Boolean = true, copyable: Boolean = false, revealed: Boolean? = null, onRevealedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onCopy: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, revealIcon: (@Composable (revealed: Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, copyIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSecretFieldLabels = MonarchSecretFieldLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

public class MonarchSecretFieldLabels(show: ((label: String) -> String)? = null, showText: String? = null, hideText: String? = null, copy: String? = null, copied: String? = null, copiedAnnouncement: String? = null, savedPlaceholder: String? = null, savedDescription: String? = null)

options.name: label
options.description: What the secret is, such as "API key". The visible label, and part of the names of the reveal and copy buttons.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the new text when the user edits the field.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown while the field is empty and focused.

options.name: errorText
options.description: The error message; replaces the helper and the saved description. An empty string counts as no error.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the user can edit the field and use its buttons.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: The secret can be revealed, selected and copied but not edited.

options.name: saved
options.description: A value is saved on the server but not sent to the app. While the field is empty it shows "Saved. Enter a new value to replace it" as the placeholder and "A value is saved and hidden. Leave blank to keep it." below; typing a value replaces it.

options.name: copyable
options.description: Shows a copy button. It copies the current value while it stays masked.

options.name: revealed
options.description: Whether the secret is shown as text. null lets the field keep this itself, starting masked.

options.name: onRevealedChange
options.description: Called with the new state when the user uses the toggle.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Called with the copied text after each copy.

options.name: revealIcon
options.description: Replaces the Show and Hide text of the toggle, for example an eye icon. Decorative.

options.name: copyIcon
options.description: Makes the copy button an icon button with this icon. Without it the button shows Copy.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: the toggle name and texts, the copy label, the copied label and announcement, and the saved placeholder and description.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the focus and press interactions of the field.

states.name: masked
states.description: Default. One dot per character; the toggle shows Show (or the icon) and is off.

states.name: revealed
states.description: The secret as text; the toggle shows Hide and is on.

states.name: saved, not shown
states.description: Empty, with the saved placeholder and description; reveal and copy are disabled until a new value is typed.

states.name: empty
states.description: Reveal and copy are disabled and drawn in the disabled colors.

states.name: copied
states.description: Below Android 13 the copy button shows Copied for two seconds; on every version TalkBack reads Copied to clipboard. Android 13 and later show their own clipboard confirmation.

states.name: error
states.description: The Material error colors on the outline and label, with the message below the field.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled colors of MonarchTextField; both buttons are disabled.

states.name: read-only
states.description: The secret can be revealed and copied but not edited.

appearance: The same field as MonarchTextField: the surface fill, the input border and medium corners, the text in the body type. The toggle text is in the strong accent color (disabled text color while it cannot act); the copy button is the small ghost Monarch button. Every color comes from the theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme.
platformNotes: The web sets autocomplete new-password and vendor attributes so browser password managers ignore the field. On Android the field uses the password keyboard without autocorrect, which stops the keyboard learning the secret, and sets no autofill content type; the system autofill service may still offer to fill it, as on iOS. The copied clip carries ClipDescription.EXTRA_IS_SENSITIVE, so Android 13 and later hide it in the clipboard preview. Monarch does not set FLAG_SECURE: a screen that shows secrets sets WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE on its window. iOS names the saved state isSet; Android uses saved, because Compose booleans drop the is prefix and set reads as a verb. The web has sm, md and lg sizes; Android has the one size of MonarchTextField. iOS shows the secret in the monospaced code type; MonarchTextField has one text style, the body type. iOS swaps a SecureField for a TextField; Compose 1.12 keeps the password flag of a text field from its first composition, so TalkBack treats the field as a password field in both states. Monarch bundles no icons, so the toggle and the copy button show words unless icons are passed.
accessibility: The field keeps its label as its name and is a password field for TalkBack.
The reveal toggle is a checkbox named "Show" and the label ("Show API key") in both states; its on or off state says whether the secret is shown.
The copy button is named "Copy" and the label ("Copy API key"), and reads Copied to clipboard as its state after a copy, through a polite live region.
Reveal and copy are disabled while the field is empty, including a saved secret that is not shown.
An error is exposed as the field's error and shown as text, not color alone.
The toggle and the copy button have 48dp touch targets after the field's text in the reading order; the saved description wraps whole at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: An empty error string counts as no error.
Copy works while the secret is masked and never reveals it.
With saved and an empty field, an empty value means keep the saved secret; the app decides that when it saves.
A long secret stays on one line and scrolls inside the field; copy still copies all of it.
Capitalisation and autocorrect are off in both states.

examples.title: Shown once, with copy
examples.template:
MonarchSecretField(
    value = secret,
    label = {{label}},
    onValueChange = { secret = it },
    helperText = {{description}},
    readOnly = true,
    copyable = true,
    revealIcon = { revealed -> MonarchIcon(if (revealed) SampleIcons.EyeOff else SampleIcons.Eye, contentDescription = null) },
    copyIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Copy, contentDescription = null) },
)
examples.code:
MonarchSecretField(
    value = secret,
    label = "Signing secret",
    onValueChange = { secret = it },
    helperText = "Shown once. Store it somewhere safe before you leave this page.",
    readOnly = true,
    copyable = true,
    revealIcon = { revealed -> MonarchIcon(if (revealed) SampleIcons.EyeOff else SampleIcons.Eye, contentDescription = null) },
    copyIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Copy, contentDescription = null) },
)

examples.title: A saved signing secret that is not shown
examples.code:
MonarchSecretField(
    value = secret,
    label = "Signing secret",
    onValueChange = { secret = it },
    saved = true,
    helperText = "Paste a new secret to replace it.",
)
